rule: change.safety_fparameter_set writes an F-parameter only when it is listed here for the F-I/O module's catalog type identifier (the nearest device item with one) and the module declares it readable and writable; F-source addresses, signatures, SIL/CRC/version and F-I/O DB assignment are never written. A row means one native write, readback and checkpoint restore passed with configured-hardware preservation; it does not validate, accept or approve a safety program. Rows come from native runs only: scripts/probe_safety_fparameters.py discovers and round-trips, scripts/safety_fparameter_allowlist.py merges a curated run.
